abstract: With the widespread adoption of sugar‐sweetened beverage (SSB) taxes, top‐down facilitation measures—designed to influence consumer tax cognition—have limited impact, even though they are widely promoted as a means of enhancing tax effectiveness. This study introduces a bottom‐up facilitation approach that targets immediate and direct information available to consumers. We examine how these two types of facilitation measures jointly affect tax policy efficacy. Results indicate that top‐down measures, such as public health education campaigns, do not significantly reduce SSB purchases when implemented alone. However, when combined with bottom‐up measures—such as displaying the specific tax amount on product labels—the tax's effectiveness increases substantially. In addition, a difference‐in‐differences style analysis reveals that the combination of top‐down and bottom‐up facilitation measures significantly reduces consumer willingness to purchase SSBs and helps mitigate reactance observed under top‐down‐only conditions, particularly among consumers who are more likely to ignore or discount the top‐down educational information about the SSB tax. These findings provide actionable insights into how the design of public health taxation—such as SSB taxes—can be optimized to strengthen behavioral responses and enhance policy outcomes.
abstract_zh: 随着含糖饮料（SSB）税收政策的广泛实施，旨在影响消费者税收认知的“自上而下”促进措施——尽管被广泛宣传为提升税收有效性的手段——实际效果有限。本研究引入了一种针对消费者即时直接信息的“自下而上”促进方法，考察这两类促进措施如何共同影响税收政策效能。结果表明，单独实施公共卫生教育宣传等自上而下措施时，并未显著减少含糖饮料购买行为。然而，当与在产品标签上显示具体税额等自下而上措施结合使用时，税收有效性大幅提升。此外，基于双重差分法的分析显示，自上而下与自下而上促进措施的组合能显著降低消费者购买含糖饮料的意愿，并有助于缓解仅在自上而下条件下观察到的消费者逆反心理——尤其对更易忽视或低估含糖饮料税自上而下教育信息的消费者群体效果显著。这些发现为优化含糖饮料税等公共卫生税收政策设计、强化行为响应及提升政策成效提供了可操作的见解。

abstract: An informed seller designs a dynamic mechanism to sell an experience good. The seller has partial information about the product match, which affects the buyer's private consumption experience. We characterize equilibrium mechanisms of this dynamic informed principal problem. The belief gap between the informed seller and the uninformed buyer, coupled with the buyer's learning, gives rise to mechanisms that provide the skeptical buyer with limited access to the product and an option to upgrade if the buyer is swayed by a good experience. Depending on the seller's screening technology, this takes the form of free/discounted trials or tiered pricing, which are prevalent in digital markets. In contrast to static environments, having consumer data can reduce sellers' revenue in equilibrium, as they fine-tune the dynamic design with their data forecasting the buyer's learning process.
abstract_zh: 一位知情卖方设计了一个动态机制来销售体验型商品。卖方对产品匹配度拥有部分信息，这影响买方私人的消费体验。我们刻画了这一动态知情委托人问题中的均衡机制。知情卖方与不知情买方之间的信念差距，加之买方的学习过程，催生了这样的机制：为持怀疑态度的买方提供有限的产品接触机会，并在买方因良好体验而动摇时给予升级选项。根据卖方的筛选技术，这表现为免费或折扣试用，或分级定价，这些在数字市场中普遍存在。与静态环境相比，拥有消费者数据可能降低卖方在均衡中的收入，因为他们利用数据预测买方的学习过程，从而微调动态设计。
title: From Doubt to Devotion: Trials and Learning-Based Pricing
title_zh: 从怀疑到忠诚：基于试验与学习的定价策略

abstract: I derive a formula for the equilibrium distribution of markups in the search-theoretic model of imperfect competition of Butters (1977), Varian (1980), and Burdett andJudd (1983).The level of markups and the sign of the relationship between a seller's markup and its size depends on the extent of search frictions, as well as on other deep parameters.Markups are efficient.Markups are positive even though the varieties produced by sellers are perfect substitutes.Markups are heterogeneous even when all sellers operate the same production technology.Markups depend on size, even though the substitutability between a variety and the others does not depend on how much of that variety is consumed.Interpreting these markups through the lens of the monopolistic competition model of Dixit and Stiglitz (1977) would lead one to recover incorrect and unstable buyers' preferences.Interpreting these markups through the lens of the Dixit-Stiglitz model would also leads to incorrect policy recommendations.These results are a cautionary note on recent work in macroeconomics.
abstract_zh: 我推导出了在Butters（1977）、Varian（1980）以及Burdett和Judd（1983）的不完全竞争搜索理论模型中，加成率均衡分布的公式。加成率的水平及其与卖方规模之间关系的符号，取决于搜索摩擦的程度以及其他深层参数。加成率是有效率的。尽管卖方生产的品种是完全替代品，加成率仍为正。即使所有卖方采用相同的生产技术，加成率也是异质的。加成率依赖于规模，尽管某一品种与其他品种之间的替代性并不取决于该品种的消费量。若通过Dixit和Stiglitz（1977）的垄断竞争模型来解读这些加成率，将会导致恢复出不正确且不稳定的买方偏好。同样，通过Dixit-Stiglitz模型解读这些加成率，也会得出错误的政策建议。这些结果对宏观经济学领域近期的研究提出了警示。
title: Markups: A Search-Theoretic Perspective
title_zh: 加成率：一个搜寻理论视角

abstract: Recent years have seen tremendous advances in the theory and application of sequential experiments. While these experiments are not always designed with hypothesis testing in mind, researchers may still be interested in performing tests after the experiment is completed. The purpose of this paper is to aid in the development of optimal tests for sequential experiments by analyzing their asymptotic properties. Our key finding is that the asymptotic power function of any test can be matched by a test in a limit experiment where a Gaussian process is observed for each treatment, and inference is made for the drifts of these processes. This result has important implications, including a powerful sufficiency result: any candidate test only needs to rely on a fixed set of statistics, regardless of the type of sequential experiment. These statistics are the number of times each treatment has been sampled by the end of the experiment, along with final value of the score (for parametric models) or efficient influence function (for non-parametric models) process for each treatment. We then characterize asymptotically optimal tests under various restrictions such as unbiasedness, α-spending constraints etc. Finally, we apply our our results to three key classes of sequential experiments: costly sampling, group sequential trials, and bandit experiments, and show how optimal inference can be conducted in these scenarios.
abstract_zh: 近年来，序贯实验的理论与应用取得了巨大进展。尽管这些实验并非总是以假设检验为设计初衷，但研究者仍可能在实验结束后有兴趣进行检验。本文旨在通过分析序贯实验的渐近性质，助力开发最优检验方法。我们的核心发现是，任何检验的渐近功效函数都可以通过一个极限实验中的检验来匹配，在该极限实验中，每种处理观测到一个高斯过程，并针对这些过程的漂移进行推断。这一结果具有重要含义，包括一个强有力的充分性结论：任何候选检验仅需依赖一组固定的统计量，无论序贯实验的类型如何。这些统计量包括实验结束时每种处理被采样的次数，以及每种处理得分（对于参数模型）或有效影响函数（对于非参数模型）过程的最终值。随后，我们在无偏性、α支出约束等各种限制条件下刻画了渐近最优检验。最后，我们将结果应用于三类关键的序贯实验：成本采样、组序贯试验和老虎机实验，并展示了在这些情境下如何进行最优推断。
title: Optimal Tests Following Sequential Experiments
title_zh: 序贯实验后的最优检验

abstract: We study the macroeconomic implications of asymmetric information in capital markets.We build a quantitative capital-accumulation model in which capital is traded in illiquid markets, with sellers having more information about capital quality than buyers.Asymmetric information distorts the terms of trade for sellers of high-quality capital, who list higher prices and are willing to accept lower trading probabilities to signal their type.Led by the model's predictions, we measure the distortions from asymmetric information by studying the relationship between listed prices and trading probabilities in a unique dataset of individual capital units listed for trade.By combining the empirical measurement with the model, we show that information asymmetries can play a quantitatively large role during economic crises when the degree of asymmetric information deteriorates.
abstract_zh: 我们研究资本市场中信息不对称对宏观经济的影响。我们构建了一个定量资本积累模型，其中资本在非流动性市场上交易，卖方对资本质量的了解程度高于买方。信息不对称扭曲了高质量资本卖方的交易条件，他们设定更高的价格，并愿意接受较低的交易概率以传递其类型信号。受模型预测的引导，我们通过研究一个独特的个体资本单位交易挂牌数据集中挂牌价格与交易概率之间的关系，来衡量信息不对称造成的扭曲。将实证测量与模型相结合，我们表明，在经济危机期间，当信息不对称程度恶化时，信息不对称可能发挥数量上显著的作用。
title: Illiquid Lemon Markets and the Macroeconomy
title_zh: 非流动性柠檬市场与宏观经济

abstract: Drafting in the swim leg of mass-start triathlon transfers a hydrodynamic cost advantage to the bike and run, where it surfaces as a change in relative rank. I use cross-stage rank improvement as a reverse proxy for free-riding and study its determinants in a ten-year panel of athlete × event records centred on 2020, when COVID-19 response policies replaced mass starts with individually staggered starts and mechanically curtailed drafting. A compact two-stage contest model, in which drafting enters the bike–run stage as a multiplicative cost shifter, organises the predictions. Identification combines pooled OLS with athlete and event fixed effects and a sharp regression-discontinuity design at the 2019/2020 cut-off. Free-riding was substantial before 2020, fell sharply in 2020 (a local-linear RDD estimate of about −31 rank places; a local-cubic estimate of about −92), and recovered only partially afterwards. The gains are largest for weaker swimmers and deeper drafting positions, the gender gap is modest, and they rise with swim-group size at an estimated log–log elasticity of about 0.43. The 2020 disruption thus acts as a contraction of the feasible set for free-riding, and its recovery is uneven rather than broad-based.
abstract_zh: 在集体出发游泳赛段中跟游所产生的流体力学成本优势会转移至自行车与跑步阶段，并表现为相对排名的变化。本文以跨赛段排名提升作为搭便车行为的反向代理指标，基于以2020年为中心的十年期运动员×赛事面板数据，研究其决定因素——2020年新冠疫情应对政策将集体出发改为间隔出发，从机制上限制了跟游行为。通过构建紧凑的两阶段竞赛模型（将跟游作为乘数型成本转移因子纳入自行车-跑步阶段）来组织预测。识别策略结合了混合OLS回归、运动员与赛事固定效应，以及以2019/2020年为断点的锐化回归断点设计。2020年前搭便车现象显著，2020年急剧下降（局部线性RDD估计值约为-31个排名位次；局部立方估计值约为-92），此后仅部分恢复。游泳能力较弱的运动员和跟游位置更靠后的选手获益最大，性别差异较小，且收益随游泳组规模扩大而增加（估计对数-对数弹性约为0.43）。因此，2020年的冲击相当于收缩了搭便车的可行集，其恢复呈现非均衡特征而非全面复苏。
title: Drafting and Free-Riding in Mass-Start Triathlon: Evidence from a COVID-19 Start-Format Discontinuity
title_zh: 大规模出发铁人三项中的跟风与搭便车：基于COVID-19出发形式断点的证据

abstract: Urban informality in Southern Europe remains an underexplored yet significant phenomenon, challenging dominant frameworks that primarily address informality in the Global South. This study examines the Centro Espansione Periferica (CEP) neighborhood in Palermo, Italy, to develop a taxonomy of informal settlement indicators suited to Southern European cities' specific governance, socio-economic, and spatial characteristics. Using a qualitative methodology grounded in Grounded Theory, this research integrates semi-structured interviews, document analysis, and field observations to capture the complexities of informality in a regulated urban environment. Findings reveal that informality in CEP emerges from economic hardship and governance failures, ambiguous tenure arrangements, and spatial adaptations within public housing initiatives. The study highlights key informality indicators, including weak institutional oversight, socio-spatial transformations, and informal negotiations between residents and public authorities. This taxonomy challenges binary classifications of informality and calls for a more nuanced, context-sensitive approach to land-use policies in European urban contexts. This research provides valuable perspectives for urban management and sustainable development approaches in cities facing comparable issues by emphasizing staged formalization, inclusive planning, and tailored policy measures.
abstract_zh: 南欧的城市非正规性仍是一个尚未充分探索却意义重大的现象，它对主要关注全球南方非正规性的主流分析框架构成了挑战。本研究以意大利巴勒莫的Centro Espansione Periferica（CEP）社区为案例，旨在构建一套适用于南欧城市特定治理、社会经济及空间特征的非正规聚落指标分类体系。研究采用基于扎根理论的定性方法，整合半结构化访谈、文献分析和实地观察，以捕捉受规制城市环境中非正规性的复杂性。研究发现，CEP的非正规性源于经济困境与治理失灵、模糊的产权安排以及公共住房项目中的空间适应性调整。研究揭示了关键的非正规性指标，包括制度监管薄弱、社会空间转型以及居民与公共当局之间的非正式协商。该分类体系挑战了非正规性的二元划分，并呼吁在欧洲城市语境下采取更具情境敏感性的土地政策路径。通过强调分阶段正规化、包容性规划及针对性政策措施，本研究为面临类似问题的城市提供了城市管理与可持续发展方面的重要参考视角。
title: Defining informality in a Southern European City indicators of informality in the CEP neighborhood, Palermo
title_zh: 定义南欧城市非正规性：巴勒莫CEP社区的非正规性指标

abstract: Global food security is increasingly challenged by issues such as population growth, cropland decline, and rapid urbanization, among which construction land expansion and its occupation of high-quality cropland have become key drivers affecting food production potential. However, existing studies have largely focused on changes in cropland quantity, with little attention to the selective occupation of high-quality cropland as well as its implications for food security. To mitigate this gap, this study develops an Indicator of the Tendency toward Preferential Occupation of high-quality cropland by construction land expansion (ITPO) based on the China Land Cover Dataset (CLCD) and farmland production potential data, which enables a quantitative assessment of the selective effects of urban expansion on cropland quality structure, hoping to provide new insights into the “land-use + food security” nexus. According to the results, several facts have been identified: (1) cropland occupied by construction land expansion exhibits a clear spatial pattern from eastern coastal regions toward inland areas. From 1985–2020, 85.93% of newly expanded construction land originated from cropland, of which 55.8% was high-quality cropland. Such occupation is primarily concentrated in major urban agglomerations, including the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Chengdu–Chongqing regions; (2) preferential occupation shows significant spatial and temporal heterogeneities, with persistent high-intensity clusters in eastern, northeastern, and central China, while western China maintains a relatively high proportion of statistically significant counties, approaching 60% in most periods (approximately 55% during 1991–2000); (3) the spatial center of both Construction Land Occupation of Cropland (CLOC) and ITPO shift westward in the study period, with a more significant displacement observed for ITPO, indicating an increasing westward redistribution of pressure on high-quality cropland; and (4) cumulative losses in food production potential caused by construction land expansion during 1985–2020 are estimated at 4.59 × 10 ¹ ⁰ kg (0.15% of total cropland potential), of which 2.69 × 10 ¹ ⁰ kg (0.09%) was high-quality cropland. Overall, although the relative intensity of preferential occupation of high-quality cropland has declined over time, its absolute loss remains substantial due to higher unit productivity and spatial concentration. By incorporating the cropland quality structure into the analysis, this study advances the understanding of the relationship between construction land expansion and food security, providing quantitative evidence to support differentiated cropland protection and territorial spatial governance strategies.
abstract_zh: 全球粮食安全日益受到人口增长、耕地减少和快速城市化等问题的挑战，其中建设用地扩张及其对优质耕地的占用已成为影响粮食生产潜力的关键因素。然而，现有研究多聚焦于耕地数量的变化，较少关注对优质耕地的选择性占用及其对粮食安全的影响。为弥补这一不足，本研究基于中国土地覆盖数据集（CLCD）和农田生产潜力数据，构建了建设用地扩张对优质耕地偏好占用倾向指标（ITPO），从而能够定量评估城市扩张对耕地质量结构的选择性效应，以期为“土地利用+粮食安全”关联提供新的见解。研究结果显示：（1）建设用地扩张所占用的耕地呈现从东部沿海地区向内陆地区转移的明显空间格局。1985—2020年间，新增建设用地中85.93%来源于耕地，其中55.8%为优质耕地。此类占用主要集中在京津冀、长三角、珠三角和成渝等主要城市群；（2）偏好占用表现出显著的时空异质性，东部、东北和中部地区存在持续的高强度集聚区，而西部地区统计显著县份比例相对较高，多数时期接近60%（1991—2000年间约为55%）；（3）研究期内，建设用地占用耕地（CLOC）和ITPO的空间重心均向西移动，其中ITPO的位移更为显著，表明优质耕地面临的压力日益向西部再分配；（4）1985—2020年间，建设用地扩张导致的粮食生产潜力累计损失估计为4.59×10¹⁰千克（占耕地总潜力的0.15%），其中优质耕地损失为2.69×10¹⁰千克（占0.09%）。总体而言，尽管优质耕地偏好占用的相对强度随时间有所下降，但由于其较高的单位生产力和空间集中性，绝对损失仍然可观。通过将耕地质量结构纳入分析，本研究深化了对建设用地扩张与粮食安全关系的理解，为差异化耕地保护和国土空间治理策略提供了定量证据支持。

abstract: This paper examines the relationship between geopolitical distance and foreign investments over time, countries, and sectors. The analysis uses comprehensive data on foreign direct investments covering greenfield projects, mergers and acquisitions, and stocks of affiliates, as well as data on four alternative measures of geopolitical distance between countries. Our gravity estimations suggest that, first, geopolitical distance has a negative effect on foreign investments and the magnitude has heightened in the post-pandemic period compared to a decade ago, in line with friendshoring forces being at play. Second, it is primarily the companies from advanced Western economies whose foreign investment decisions are increasingly shaped by friendshoring forces. Finally, the paper shows that friendshoring is not only confined to strategic industries, implying that it may not solely reflect national security or resilience considerations.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了地缘政治距离与外国投资在不同时间、国家和部门之间的关系。分析采用了涵盖绿地项目、并购及附属公司股票的外国直接投资综合数据，以及国家间四种替代性地缘政治距离衡量指标的数据。我们的引力模型估计表明：首先，地缘政治距离对外国投资有负面影响，且其影响程度在疫情后时期相较于十年前有所加剧，这与友岸外包力量的作用相符。其次，主要是来自西方发达经济体的公司，其对外投资决策日益受到友岸外包力量的影响。最后，本文显示友岸外包不仅局限于战略行业，这意味着它可能不仅仅反映国家安全或韧性考量。
title: Geopolitical fragmentation and friendshoring evidence from project-level foreign investments data
title_zh: 地缘政治碎片化与友岸外包：基于项目层面外国投资数据的证据

abstract: Voting is a cornerstone of democratic decision-making, but it may also diffuse individual responsibility, potentially encouraging people to support actions they would avoid when deciding alone. Such diffusion of responsibility could lead voters to prioritize relative standing over collective welfare, for example by endorsing policies that reduce others’ advantages even at a cost to overall efficiency. Across two experiments (total N = 1750), including a preregistered replication, we examined whether voting contributes to envy-driven behavior in distributive decisions. Participants made choices in redistribution games under three decision-making rules: individually, through majority voting, or, in Study 2, via a Random Dictator mechanism that involved group decision-making without majority rule. In both studies, voting contributed to a higher rate of envy-driven choices, in which participants sacrificed efficiency to reduce disadvantageous inequality. This effect replicated with nearly identical magnitude in the preregistered study and was strongest when the personal cost of acting enviously was low. Results from the Random Dictator condition indicated that group decision-making alone increased envy-driven behavior, consistent with diffusion of responsibility, while majority rule amplified this effect further. These findings suggest that collective decision-making can shift social preferences by diffusing personal responsibility, thereby fostering competitive motives rather than cooperative ones. This psychological mechanism helps explain why democratic decisions about redistribution may sometimes reflect relative concerns rather than collective welfare.
abstract_zh: 投票是民主决策的基石，但它也可能分散个人责任，从而可能鼓励人们支持那些在独自决策时会避免的行为。这种责任分散可能导致选民优先考虑相对地位而非集体福利，例如支持那些以减少他人优势为代价、即使损害整体效率也在所不惜的政策。通过两项实验（总样本量N=1750），包括一项预注册复制实验，我们考察了投票是否在分配决策中促成嫉妒驱动的行为。参与者在三种决策规则下进行再分配博弈：个人决策、多数投票决策，或在研究2中通过随机独裁者机制进行的不涉及多数规则的群体决策。两项研究均表明，投票提高了嫉妒驱动选择的比例，即参与者牺牲效率以减少不利不平等。这一效应在预注册研究中以几乎相同的幅度得到复制，并且在采取嫉妒行为的个人成本较低时最为显著。随机独裁者条件的结果表明，仅群体决策本身就会增加嫉妒驱动行为，这与责任分散一致，而多数规则进一步放大了这一效应。这些发现表明，集体决策通过分散个人责任可以改变社会偏好，从而促进竞争动机而非合作动机。这一心理机制有助于解释为何关于再分配的民主决策有时可能反映相对关切而非集体福利。
title: Envy in the Ballot Box: How Voting Influences Distributive Preferences
title_zh: 投票箱中的嫉妒：投票如何影响分配偏好

abstract: Land fragmentation is widely recognized as a constraint on smallholder agriculture, raising production costs, limiting mechanization, and reducing efficiency. Land consolidation programs have been introduced in many countries to address this problem, yet their economic effects depend not only on plot reconfiguration but also on institutional implementation and land market functioning. This paper examines the impacts of Vietnam's state‐led land consolidation program using six waves of household panel data (2008–2018) from two provinces where consolidation was implemented. Impacts are estimated with two‐way fixed effects and a staggered difference‐in‐differences approach that accounts for heterogeneous adoption timing. The results show that the consolidation program substantially reduced land fragmentation: the number of plots per household fell by roughly three plots, average plot size increased by about 66 percent, and the distance between plots and homesteads declined by approximately 23 percent. At the same time, administrative delays in reissuing land‐use‐right certificates temporarily reduced the share of titled and collateral‐eligible land. While households’ overall access to credit is not adversely affected, land rental markets are significantly disrupted, with both rent‐in and rent‐out declining. Such reductions in land transactions may impede efficient land reallocation and operational scale adjustment, thereby delaying investment and productivity gains from improved land structure. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of institutional implementation and complementary market functioning for realizing the benefits of land consolidation in Vietnam and other smallholder economies.
abstract_zh: 土地细碎化被广泛认为是制约小农农业的瓶颈，它提高了生产成本、限制了机械化进程并降低了生产效率。许多国家推行了土地整合计划以应对这一问题，但其经济效果不仅取决于地块重组，还依赖于制度实施和土地市场运行。本文利用越南两个实施土地整合省份的六轮农户面板数据（2008-2018年），考察了该国政府主导的土地整合计划的影响。采用双向固定效应和考虑异质性采纳时点的交错双重差分法进行效应估计。结果显示：土地整合计划显著降低了土地细碎化程度——每户地块数量减少约3块，平均地块面积增加约66%，地块与宅基地距离缩短约23%。与此同时，重新颁发土地使用权证过程中的行政延迟导致有证土地和可抵押土地比例暂时下降。虽然农户整体信贷获取未受负面影响，但土地租赁市场受到显著干扰，租入和租出行为均出现减少。这种土地交易的缩减可能阻碍土地有效再配置和经营规模调整，从而延缓因土地结构改善带来的投资和生产率提升。总体而言，研究结果凸显了制度实施与配套市场功能对越南及其他小农经济体实现土地整合效益的关键作用。
title: Land Consolidation, Tenure Documentation, and Land Rental Markets: Evidence from rural Vietnam
title_zh: 土地整合、产权登记与土地租赁市场：来自越南农村的证据

abstract: This study reassesses the impact of the historical BSE outbreak on EU diets, showing that consumption patterns shifted persistently even after policy actions eliminated the food safety risk. Utilizing advanced difference‐in‐differences techniques on 1980–2020 data, we demonstrate that while beef consumption exhibited a transient U‐shaped recovery relative to other meats, it declined sharply compared to plant‐based products, with average reductions of 79%, 29%, and 28% for pulses, cereals, and vegetable oils, respectively. This highlights a structural dietary change, overlooked by previous analyses focused on meat substitution. Results are robust to sensitivity analyses. Understanding the primary drivers behind the structural shift in EU consumer diets over recent decades is crucial for future research investigating the reduction in red meat consumption driven by environmental and health concerns in high‐income countries.
abstract_zh: 本研究重新评估了历史上疯牛病疫情对欧盟饮食结构的影响，结果表明即使在政策行动消除食品安全风险后，消费模式仍发生了持续性转变。基于1980-2020年数据，采用先进的双重差分技术，我们发现：牛肉消费相对于其他肉类呈现短暂的U型恢复，但相较于植物性产品则显著下降——豆类、谷物和植物油的消费量平均分别减少79%、29%和28%。这揭示了以往聚焦肉类替代效应的研究所忽视的结构性饮食变迁。敏感性分析证实了结果的稳健性。理解近几十年来欧盟消费者饮食结构变迁的主要驱动力，对于未来研究高收入国家因环境和健康担忧导致红肉消费减少的课题具有关键意义。
title: From Meat to Plant‐Based Products? The Enduring Impact of BSE on Beef Consumption
title_zh: 从肉类到植物基产品？疯牛病对牛肉消费的持久影响

abstract: In real estate markets featuring substantial search friction and strong seller loss aversion, external shocks that shift buyer valuations are largely reflected in liquidity fluctuations, while price adjustments tend to be rigid. This study examines market liquidity shifts following the tightening of South Korean farmland ownership regulations, utilizing the 2021 Farmland Act amendment and nationwide parcel‐level transaction data (2013−2023). We estimate the relationships between land liquidity, policy change, and key macro variables (i.e. interest rates) using a monthly county fixed‐effects model. We find that the amendment is significantly associated with a 10%−11% reduction in nationwide market liquidity, as measured by the turnover rate. This negative relationship is geographically heterogeneous, being more pronounced in rural areas while statistically insignificant in investment‐driven urban areas. Furthermore, our decomposition analysis reveals that the post‐enforcement drop in observed market liquidity is mostly associated with rising interest rates. The role of interest rates is more dominant in urbanized areas than rural ones, reflecting the higher concentration of investment‐driven buyers and substantial capital requirements for land acquisition in these regions. Our findings demonstrate that the market response to ownership regulation is strongly mediated by local market conditions, highlighting the challenges of enforcing stringent policies in areas with high investment potential.
abstract_zh: 在具有显著搜索摩擦和强烈卖方损失厌恶特征的房地产市场中，改变买方估值的外部冲击主要反映在流动性波动上，而价格调整往往呈现刚性。本研究利用2021年《农地法》修正案及2013-2023年全国地块层面交易数据，考察韩国农地所有权监管收紧后的市场流动性变化。我们采用月度县级固定效应模型，估计土地流动性、政策变化与关键宏观变量（如利率）之间的关系。研究发现，该修正案与全国市场流动性（以周转率衡量）显著下降10%-11%相关。这种负向关系存在地理异质性：在农村地区更为显著，而在投资驱动的城市地区统计上不显著。此外，分解分析表明，政策实施后观察到的市场流动性下降主要与利率上升相关。利率在城市化地区的作用比农村地区更为突出，这反映了这些地区投资驱动型买家的高度集中以及土地收购所需的大量资本。我们的研究结果表明，市场对所有权监管的反应受到当地市场条件的强烈调节，凸显了在高投资潜力地区实施严格政策的挑战。
title: Farmland Liquidity Under a Tightened Ownership Regime: Urban–Rural Heterogeneity in South Korea
title_zh: 收紧所有权制度下的农地流动性：韩国的城乡异质性

abstract: Activity shortfalls are more costly than strong activity. I consider optimal monetary policy under discretion with an asymmetric (shortfalls) loss function in a natural rate model. The optimal monetary policy exacerbates shortfalls, owing to the adjustment of expectations implied by the natural rate hypothesis, and leads to an inflationary bias. Mandating a central bank objective with greater symmetry lowers activity shortfalls and inflation bias. The model also implies that an optimal monetary policy does not accommodate fluctuations from aggregate demand shocks. The analysis implies that monetary accommodation of strong economic activity requires justifications other than asymmetric costs of shortfalls.
abstract_zh: 活动缺口比强劲活动代价更高。本文在自然率模型下，考虑具有非对称（缺口）损失函数的相机抉择最优货币政策。由于自然率假说所隐含的预期调整，最优货币政策会加剧活动缺口，并导致通胀偏差。设定更具对称性的央行目标可降低活动缺口与通胀偏差。该模型还表明，最优货币政策不会对总需求冲击引发的波动进行调节。分析表明，对强劲经济活动的货币调节需要以缺口非对称成本之外的理由作为依据。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Monetary Policy, Employment Shortfalls, and the Natural Rate Hypothesis
title_zh: 货币政策、就业缺口与自然率假说

abstract: This article uses the township‐level data on welfare expenditure and provision gathered by parish officers in England and Wales at three points between 1776 and 1815 to illuminate regional and local differences during the period. These data have been linked to geographic information system (GIS) mapping systems, facilitating the mapping of parish/township level welfare data across a wide range of variables. Appropriate linkage to the 1801 and 1811 census data and the 1815 income tax property valuations also permits new village‐level estimates of the prevalence, affordability, and typology of welfare provision. The results challenge current hypotheses about regional differences in how the Poor Law was administered.
abstract_zh: 本文利用1776年至1815年间英格兰与威尔士教区官员收集的三个时间点的乡镇级福利支出与供给数据，揭示该时期区域与地方差异。这些数据已与地理信息系统（GIS）制图系统关联，从而能够基于广泛变量绘制教区/乡镇级福利数据地图。通过将数据与1801年及1811年人口普查数据、1815年所得税财产估值进行适当关联，还可对福利供给的普及程度、可负担性及类型进行新的村级估算。研究结果对当前关于济贫法实施区域差异的假说提出了挑战。
title: Regional and local divergence in welfare provision in England and Wales, 1776–1815
title_zh: 1776-1815年英格兰与威尔士福利供给的区域与地方分化

abstract: Voluntary agricultural land retirement programs are widely recognized for their environmental benefits, yet their economic effects, particularly on labor markets and land tenure, remain less understood. This paper examines the short‐ and long‐term impacts of the first large‐scale US land retirement initiative, the historical Conservation Reserve Program, introduced under the 1956 Set‐Aside Act. Between 1957 and 1960, the program enrolled more than 30 million acres under 3‐, 5‐, or 10‐year contracts, which then expired gradually through 1970. Using a newly digitized Conservation Reserve Program enrollment database linked to agricultural census data from the 1950s through the 1970s, we find that counties with medium and high enrollment intensity experienced statistically significant declines in tenant‐cultivated land relative to low‐enrollment counties during the program's active years. In medium‐enrollment counties, tenant‐operated land declined by roughly 0.6 percentage points, while high‐enrollment counties experienced declines of approximately 1.6 percentage points nationally. The proportion of tenant farm operators also fell in both medium‐ and high‐enrollment counties. These effects were larger and more persistent in the South, especially in counties with higher shares of nonwhite farm operators and sharecropping.
abstract_zh: 自愿性农业土地休耕项目因其环境效益而广受认可，但其经济影响——特别是对劳动力市场和土地保有权的影响——仍鲜为人知。本文考察了美国首个大规模土地休耕计划——1956年《预留法案》下设立的历史性保护储备计划——的短期与长期影响。1957年至1960年间，该计划以3年、5年或10年合同形式纳入了超过3000万英亩土地，这些合同随后于1970年前逐步到期。通过将新数字化的保护储备计划登记数据库与20世纪50年代至70年代的农业普查数据相关联，我们发现：在项目活跃期，中等和高强度登记县相对于低登记县，租佃耕地面积出现了统计上显著的下降。在全国范围内，中等登记县的租佃经营土地面积下降约0.6个百分点，而高登记县则下降约1.6个百分点。中等和高登记县的租佃农场经营者比例也同步下降。这些效应在南方地区更为显著且持久，尤其在非白人农场经营者及分成制佃农比例较高的县份表现突出。
title: Consequences of land retirement policies on agricultural labor and land tenure: Evidence from the historical Conservation Reserve Program in the United States
title_zh: 土地休耕政策对农业劳动力和土地保有权的影响：来自美国历史性保护储备计划的证据

abstract: We develop a structural framework to identify the sources of cross‐state heterogeneity in response to U.S. tariff changes. A unilateral 25‐percentage‐point U.S. tariff increase across sectors induces consumption changes ranging from −0.8% in Oregon to 2.3% in Montana. This variation stems from the interaction between states' internal comparative advantage and the nation's external comparative advantage. Factor mobility lowers aggregate consumption and reshapes the cross‐state impacts by shifting resources toward more distorted states and sectors. Consequently, preferred tariff changes vary systematically across states, necessitating transfers to align regional policy incentives. Foreign retaliation reduces aggregate gains while perpetuating cross‐state variation.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个结构性框架，用以识别美国关税变化中各州异质性反应的来源。若美国对各行业统一加征25个百分点的关税，各州消费变化幅度从俄勒冈州的-0.8%到蒙大拿州的2.3%不等。这种差异源于各州内部比较优势与国家外部比较优势之间的相互作用。要素流动性通过将资源向扭曲程度更高的州和行业转移，降低了总体消费水平并重塑了跨州影响。因此，各州偏好的关税变化呈现系统性差异，需要通过转移支付来协调区域政策激励。外国报复性措施在减少总体收益的同时，进一步加剧了跨州差异。
title: What Determines State Heterogeneity in Response to U.S. Tariff Changes?
title_zh: 美国关税变化下各州异质性反应的决定因素是什么？

abstract: China’s agricultural sector is a key contributor to global carbon emissions, making improvements in Agricultural Carbon Emission Efficiency (ACEE) crucial for achieving climate and food security goals. Departing from traditional studies that often assume a singular nationwide evolutionary path, this research investigates the divergent convergence dynamics of ACEE through the lens of land-use modes to map its long-term evolution. By applying a club convergence methodology to provincial panel data from 2004 to 2020, we reject the hypothesis of a unique steady state and identify instead five distinct convergence clubs with heterogeneous equilibrium pathways, alongside a small group of non-converging provinces. The results reveal that agricultural land-use modes act as a fundamental sorting mechanism: while diversified systems generally facilitate higher efficiency equilibria, specialized production bases often face efficiency bottlenecks despite their scale advantages. Furthermore, the economic drivers of efficiency differ markedly across clusters, showing that imbalanced fixed-asset investment constrains further gains in high-efficiency regions, whereas narrowing urban-rural income gaps consistently supports efficiency across most clubs. These findings underscore the necessity of club-specific, locally adapted strategies that align production systems, land-use modes, and factor inputs with regional realities to foster sustainable agricultural development and enhance China's contribution to global carbon reduction.
abstract_zh: 中国农业部门是全球碳排放的重要贡献者，因此提升农业碳排放效率（ACEE）对于实现气候与粮食安全目标至关重要。不同于传统研究往往假设全国存在单一演化路径，本研究从土地利用模式的视角探讨ACEE的差异化收敛动态，以描绘其长期演变趋势。通过将俱乐部收敛方法应用于2004年至2020年的省级面板数据，我们拒绝了单一稳态的假设，识别出五个具有异质性均衡路径的收敛俱乐部，以及一小部分不收敛的省份。研究结果显示，农业土地利用模式作为基本的分类机制发挥作用：多元化系统通常促进更高效率的均衡状态，而专业化生产基地尽管具有规模优势，却常面临效率瓶颈。此外，各俱乐部间的经济驱动因素差异显著，表明固定资本投资失衡限制了高效率地区的进一步增益，而缩小城乡收入差距在大多数俱乐部中持续支持效率提升。这些发现强调了针对俱乐部特定、因地制宜策略的必要性，使生产系统、土地利用模式和要素投入与区域实际相匹配，以促进农业可持续发展，并增强中国对全球碳减排的贡献。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Agricultural carbon emission efficiency and its regional convergence in China: Role of land use modes and economic factors
title_zh: 中国农业碳排放效率及其区域收敛性：土地利用模式与经济因素的作用

abstract: Biodiversity loss, driven by human activities such as land-use change, climate change, and pollution, is a critical global challenge. Effective sustainability performance assessments, especially at the national level, require tools that account for biophysical characteristics alongside economic and social factors. Current methods often overlook the ecological constraints and opportunities shaped by biomes—large-scale regions defined by climatic and ecological attributes that influence ecosystem services. This study introduces Econobiome classifications, a novel country categorization system based on terrestrial ecosystem composition and the spatial distribution of economic activities, including agriculture, forestry, and night light data. Using partitioning clustering techniques, we classify countries into four distinct groupings: cropland (11 clusters), forestry (5 clusters), night light (7 clusters), and all activities (7 clusters). The classifications highlight how dominant biomes and economic activity locations shape ecological conditions and sustainability constraints. We apply the Econobiome framework to benchmark the environmental efficiency of national agricultural systems (NAS) using data envelopment analysis (DEA). Results reveal significant variation in eco-efficiency across clusters, underscoring the importance of context-sensitive comparisons in sustainability diagnostics. While the Econobiome framework improves ecological comparability across countries, it relies on national-scale data and does not capture subnational ecological and socio-economic variation. Yet, the Econobiome classification provides policymakers and researchers with a robust tool to align environmental assessments with ecological realities, improving the accuracy of sustainability benchmarks and supporting evidence-based decision-making in the face of the biodiversity crisis.
abstract_zh: 生物多样性丧失，由土地利用变化、气候变化和污染等人类活动驱动，是全球面临的严峻挑战。有效的可持续性绩效评估，尤其是在国家层面，需要能够兼顾生物物理特征与经济和社会因素的工具。当前方法往往忽视了由生物群落——即由影响生态系统服务的气候和生态属性定义的大规模区域——所塑造的生态约束与机遇。本研究引入了Econobiome分类法，这是一种基于陆地生态系统组成及经济活动空间分布（包括农业、林业和夜间灯光数据）的新型国家分类体系。利用分区聚类技术，我们将国家划分为四个不同的组别：农田（11个聚类）、林业（5个聚类）、夜间灯光（7个聚类）及所有活动（7个聚类）。这些分类突显了主导生物群落和经济活动位置如何塑造生态条件和可持续性约束。我们应用Econobiome框架，通过数据包络分析（DEA）对国家农业系统（NAS）的环境效率进行基准评估。结果显示各聚类间生态效率存在显著差异，强调了在可持续性诊断中考虑情境敏感性比较的重要性。尽管Econobiome框架提高了国家间的生态可比性，但它依赖于国家尺度数据，未能捕捉次国家层面的生态和社会经济变异。然而，Econobiome分类为政策制定者和研究人员提供了一个强有力的工具，使环境评估与生态现实相契合，提高了可持续性基准的准确性，并在生物多样性危机面前支持基于证据的决策。
title: Econobiomes: A terrestrial-based country classification for international sustainability comparison
title_zh: 生态生物群落：基于陆地的国家分类用于国际可持续性比较

abstract: Rapid urbanization is transforming the structure of agriculture across Africa; however, its impact on crop diversification remains debated. Using georeferenced data from the Tanzania LSMS-ISA survey and a double-hurdle econometric model, this study examines the motivators of diversification in peri-urban environments. We compare mainland with the extreme land scarcity and real-estate pressures of Zanzibar; we find important structural paradoxes. First, a negative relationship exists between formal land tenure and the degree of diversification. This finding suggests that property rights in hyper-specified markets provide incentives to the commodification of land and monoculture instead of complex farming systems. Second, the study dismisses the linear scale-diversification hypothesis by showing a strong u-shaped pattern in the mainland peri-urban zones. Micro-holders diversify mainly for survival (distress push) while large commercial farms diversify for profit (accumulation push) and leave medium-scale operations to specialize. Moreover, biophysical factors, especially heavy clay soils, significantly restrict diversification options regardless of economic incentives. These results raise questions about the validity of uniform policy frameworks and suggest that conventional land titling programs, highly speculative real-estate markets could potentially harm agro-biodiversity in rapidly growing island economies unless they are accompanied by agricultural conservation programs.
abstract_zh: 快速城市化正在改变非洲的农业结构，然而其对作物多样化的影响仍存争议。本研究利用坦桑尼亚LSMS-ISA调查的地理参照数据，并采用双重门槛计量经济模型，探讨了城郊环境中多样化的驱动因素。我们将大陆与土地极度稀缺且面临房地产压力的桑给巴尔进行比较，发现了重要的结构性悖论。首先，正式土地权属与多样化程度之间存在负相关关系。这一发现表明，在高度特定化的市场中，产权激励了土地商品化和单一作物种植，而非复杂的农业系统。其次，本研究否定了线性规模-多样化假说，揭示了大陆城郊区域呈现强烈的U型模式。微型农户主要出于生存需求（困境推动）而多样化，大型商业农场则为了利润（积累推动）而多样化，而中等规模经营则趋于专业化。此外，生物物理因素，尤其是重黏土土壤，显著限制了多样化选择，无论经济激励如何。这些结果对统一政策框架的有效性提出质疑，并表明，除非伴随农业保护计划，否则常规的土地确权项目和高度投机的房地产市场可能对快速发展的岛屿经济中的农业生物多样性造成潜在损害。
title: The speculation trap and the distress push: Divergent pathways of peri-urban agriculture in Tanzania
title_zh: 投机陷阱与困境推动：坦桑尼亚城郊农业的分化路径

abstract: Interest has grown in how to achieve healthy, sustainable, and affordable human diets. The potential income and employment effects of a transition towards healthier diets have received much less attention. We simulate aggregate and sectoral income and employment for business-as-usual and healthier diets for all geographic regions up to 2050 using scenario-based modelling. These healthier diets can increase food’s share of household expenditure in some regions, for example from 18% to 25% in East and Central Africa in 2050. Our results suggest that a global shift towards healthier diets leads to a reallocation of primary factors of production, especially low-skilled labour and capital, from non-agricultural sectors to crop agriculture in parts of sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. Notably, in 2050, with healthier diets, agriculture’s share of low-skilled labour increases by 3.2 percentage points in East and Central Africa and 1.5 percentage points in South Asia excluding India. Although Gross Domestic Product increases in these regions relative to business-as-usual, this reallocation raises agriculture’s share of Gross Domestic Product, consistent with a slower pace of long-run structural transformation. The reallocation leads to a mild increase in wages for low-skilled workers relative to high-skilled workers in most of these regions, compared to business-as-usual. However, in parts of sub-Saharan Africa, food price increases outweigh wage gains for low-skilled labour, reducing real purchasing power. Policies that encourage healthier diets may also alter income and employment and reduce economic welfare of poor populations in some regions, so care is needed in policy design to avoid adverse unintended consequences.
abstract_zh: 近年来，人们越来越关注如何实现健康、可持续且负担得起的人类饮食。然而，向更健康饮食转变可能带来的潜在收入和就业影响却较少受到关注。我们采用基于情景的建模方法，模拟了到2050年，在一切照旧和更健康饮食两种情境下，所有地理区域的总体及部门收入与就业情况。这些更健康的饮食在某些地区可能会增加食品在家庭支出中的份额，例如，到2050年，在东部和中部非洲，这一比例将从18%上升至25%。我们的研究结果表明，全球向更健康饮食的转变将导致生产要素，尤其是低技能劳动力和资本，从非农业部门向撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚部分地区的作物农业重新配置。值得注意的是，到2050年，在更健康饮食情境下，农业在低技能劳动力中的占比在东部和中部非洲将增加3.2个百分点，在除印度外的南亚地区将增加1.5个百分点。尽管这些地区的国内生产总值相对于一切照旧情境有所增长，但这种重新配置提高了农业在国内生产总值中的份额，这与长期结构转型步伐放缓相一致。与一切照旧情境相比，这种重新配置在大多数这些地区导致低技能工人相对于高技能工人的工资温和上涨。然而，在撒哈拉以南非洲的部分地区，食品价格上涨超过了低技能劳动力的工资增长，从而降低了实际购买力。鼓励更健康饮食的政策也可能改变收入和就业状况，并在某些地区降低贫困人口的经济福利，因此在政策设计时需谨慎，以避免产生不利的意外后果。
title: Healthier diets: a global economic modelling study of income and employment impacts across regions
title_zh: 更健康的饮食：一项关于收入和就业影响的全球区域经济建模研究

abstract: We present the first quantitative evaluation of the overall impact and distributional effects of railroad access on industrial growth in historical China. Using newly digitized data on railroad expansion and distance to hypothetical railroad networks as instruments, we find that railroad access significantly increased the annual entry of local industrial firms from 1858 to 1936 and industrial output in 1933. However, the effect is highly localized, concentrated in counties within 10 km of railroad lines, and stronger in historical population and transportation centers. Using a causal mediation framework to analyze the textile industry, we find that railroads facilitated firm entry primarily by enhancing market access to manufactured yarn and lowering travel costs for workers and technicians. Further evidence shows that access to railroads promoted technology adoption.
abstract_zh: 我们首次对历史中国铁路通达对工业增长的整体影响及其分配效应进行了定量评估。利用新数字化的铁路扩张数据及至假设铁路网络的距离作为工具变量，我们发现铁路通达显著增加了1858年至1936年间地方工业企业的新增进入数量，并提升了1933年的工业产出。然而，这一效应高度局部化，集中于铁路线10公里范围内的县，且在历史人口与交通中心更为显著。通过运用因果中介框架分析纺织业，我们发现铁路主要通过增强对机制纱的市场准入及降低工人和技术人员的旅行成本来促进企业进入。进一步证据表明，铁路通达还促进了技术采纳。

abstract: How do U.S. monetary tightening shocks affect emerging market economies, and how does the impact depend on these economies’ own macroeconomic vulnerabilities? We examine this question in a model that combines financial frictions with imperfect anchoring of inflation expectations, a key vulnerability in emerging markets. The degree of anchoring is disciplined using evidence that inflation expectations in emerging markets respond significantly to inflation surprises. Imperfect anchoring amplifies the contractionary effects of U.S. monetary shocks on emerging markets but also generates increases in inflation and nominal interest rates, patterns that we show are consistent with the empirical evidence but are not well explained by existing models. Our analysis also distinguishes between the drivers of U.S. policy tightenings. U.S. interest rate hikes resulting from stronger demand, rather than exogenous policy shocks, lead to modestly positive spillovers for emerging markets with well-anchored inflation expectations, but to substantial slowdowns in those with less-well-anchored expectations.
abstract_zh: 美国的货币紧缩冲击如何影响新兴市场经济体，这种影响又如何取决于这些经济体自身的宏观脆弱性？我们在一个结合金融摩擦与通胀预期不完全锚定的模型中探讨此问题，后者是新兴市场的一个关键脆弱性。锚定程度通过新兴市场通胀预期对通胀意外显著反应的证据加以约束。不完全锚定放大了美国货币冲击对新兴市场的紧缩效应，但也导致通胀和名义利率上升，我们展示这些模式与实证证据一致，而现有模型未能充分解释。我们的分析还区分了美国政策收紧的驱动因素。源于需求增强而非外生政策冲击的美国利率上调，对通胀预期锚定良好的新兴市场产生适度正向外溢效应，但对锚定较差的经济体则导致显著放缓。
title: U.S. monetary spillovers to emerging markets: Both policy drivers and vulnerabilities matter
title_zh: 美国货币政策对新兴市场的溢出效应：政策驱动因素与脆弱性均至关重要

abstract: Violence is often viewed as an intrinsic feature of illicit markets, driven by competition, disputes, and predation. We argue that the connection between violence and markets is not exclusive to illicit markets and that in the absence of strong institutions these factors exist ubiquitously. Using an estimator of spatial concentration, we document the empirical relationship between violence and markets in the Fourteenth Century. We then employ a large language model to analyze the coroner’s accounts of the era’s homicides, finding that many of these incidents were driven by avoidable escalations of business-related disputes. Employing a difference-in-differences estimator for spatial concentration, we proceed to causally identify the impacts of the introduction of London’s first professional police force in the nineteenth century on this concentration. We find that the police force’s introduction led to a 54% reduction in the degree of concentration of violence around marketplaces. Our findings suggest that it is not the nature of the commodities being sold in illicit markets that drives violence, but is rather the absence of formal institutions of enforcement and dispute resolution.
abstract_zh: 暴力常被视为非法市场的固有特征，源于竞争、纠纷与掠夺。我们认为，暴力与市场之间的联系并非仅限于非法市场，在缺乏强有力制度的情况下，这些因素普遍存在。利用空间集中度估计方法，我们记录了十四世纪暴力与市场之间的实证关系。随后，我们运用大型语言模型分析该时代验尸官记录中的凶杀案，发现许多此类事件源于商业纠纷的可避免升级。采用双重差分估计器分析空间集中度，我们进一步因果识别了十九世纪伦敦首支职业警察部队的引入对这一集中度的影响。我们发现，警察部队的引入导致市场周边暴力集中度下降了54%。我们的研究结果表明，驱动暴力的并非非法市场所售商品的性质，而是缺乏正式的执法与纠纷解决制度。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Murder in the Marketplace
title_zh: 市场中的谋杀

abstract: Political coercion directed against non-state moralities can serve as a tool for generating legitimacy. Does the efficacy of political coercion in producing legitimacy vary with its intensity? Using Freedom House, V-Dem, and Polity5 indices as proxies for coercive intensity, together with data on regime legitimacy and survival, we find that a mid-level range of coercion is ineffective in generating legitimacy. Relatively few regimes operate in this intermediate zone, and those that do exhibit lower legitimacy and higher instability risks. In contrast, shifts away from this suboptimal range-toward either higher or lower coercion levels-correlate significantly with gains in legitimacy. Time-series analysis of authoritarian regimes reveals a recurring pattern: gradual reductions in coercion that drift into this inefficient mid-range, followed by sharp increases. This dynamic suggests that coercion carries substantial exogenous costs such as economic and reputational costs and that delayed feedback on its legitimacy effects produces overshooting. Drawing on historical cases such as the USSR, we argue that moderate coercion proves inefficient due to an intrinsic negative reaction to coercion, or coercion resentment.
abstract_zh: 针对非国家道德的政治强制可成为合法性生成的工具。政治强制在产生合法性方面的效力是否会随其强度变化？通过使用自由之家、V-Dem和Polity5指数作为强制强度的代理变量，结合政权合法性与存续数据，我们发现中等强度的强制区间无法有效生成合法性。相对较少的政权处于这一中间地带，而处于该区间的政权表现出较低的合法性和较高的不稳定风险。相反，偏离这一次优区间——无论是向更高还是更低强制水平移动——与合法性提升显著相关。对威权政权的时间序列分析揭示了一种反复出现的模式：逐步降低强制力度会滑入这一低效的中间区间，随后出现急剧的强制升级。这一动态表明，强制会带来显著的外生成本（如经济成本和声誉成本），而对其合法性效应的延迟反馈会导致过度调整。借鉴苏联等历史案例，我们认为，由于强制会引发内在的负面反应（即强制怨恨），温和的强制被证明是低效的。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: The inefficiency of moderate political coercion: a cross-country comparison of coercion intensity, state legitimacy, and regime stability
title_zh: 温和政治胁迫的低效性：胁迫强度、国家合法性与政权稳定性的跨国比较

abstract: Milton Friedman, in the 1960s, was convinced that John Cowperthwaite, the British official overseeing Hong Kong’s economic policy, was conducting the most radical experiment in economic history. A staunch classical liberal within the British civil service, Cowperthwaite aggressively resisted government intervention, believing that free markets fueled growth. His influence was amplified by British domestic politics and the nature of colonial rule, making him a uniquely powerful figure. In this paper, we use the Synthetic Control Method (SCM) and Synthetic Difference-in-Differences (SDID) to assess whether Cowperthwaite truly constrained government expansion and whether his policies drove economic growth. In other words, we test whether Friedman overstated Cowperthwaite’s impact. We find strong evidence that Cowperthwaite limited government growth but had no visible effect on economic growth. We link these results to Hong Kong’s land policies, their impact on government size metrics, and more even-handed assessments of Cowperthwaite’s policy decisions.
abstract_zh: 20世纪60年代，米尔顿·弗里德曼确信，负责香港经济政策的英国官员约翰·考珀斯韦特正在实施经济史上最激进的实验。作为英国文官体系中坚定的古典自由主义者，考珀斯韦特强烈抵制政府干预，坚信自由市场能推动增长。英国国内政治与殖民统治的特性放大了他的影响力，使其成为一位拥有独特权力的关键人物。本文采用合成控制法（SCM）与合成双重差分法（SDID），评估考珀斯韦特是否真正限制了政府扩张，以及他的政策是否推动了经济增长。换言之，我们检验弗里德曼是否夸大了考珀斯韦特的影响。研究发现，考珀斯韦特确实限制了政府规模增长，但对经济增长并无显著影响。我们将这些结果与香港的土地政策、其对政府规模指标的影响，以及对考珀斯韦特政策决策更为公允的评价联系起来。

abstract: This study examines the causal effects of anti-corruption reforms on wealth concentration. Using data from the World Inequality Database, the World Governance Indicators, and V-Dem across more than 150 countries, I employ a staggered difference-in-differences approach to identify the impact of sustained drops in measured corruption on wealth distribution. Sustained anti-corruption reforms significantly reduce wealth concentration at the top while increasing shares at the bottom of the distribution. Ten years after implementation, the top 1% wealth share falls by approximately 2 percentage points and the top 10% share by 1.5 percentage points, while the bottom 50% share rises by 0.4 percentage points and the bottom 20% share by 0.15 percentage points. These effects emerge gradually, becoming statistically significant within four years of reforms and persisting throughout the observation period. The results are robust across alternative estimators, alternative corruption indicators, and specifications that control for lagged dependent variables, national income, the top 1% income share, political violence, and inflation. A synthetic control analysis of Georgia illustrates how reforms disrupt elite patronage networks, while the subsequent policy reversal caused distributional gains to stagnate. The findings extend the political economy literature by showing that elite-disrupting mechanisms dominate offsetting concerns about informal redistribution and that reforms reshape wealth distribution through expanded access to financial services and property rights rather than through direct fiscal transfers.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了反腐败改革对财富集中的因果效应。基于来自世界不平等数据库、世界治理指标及V-Dem项目覆盖150多个国家的数据，我采用交错双重差分法识别腐败程度持续下降对财富分配的影响。持续的反腐败改革显著降低了顶层财富集中度，同时提高了底层群体的财富占比。改革实施十年后，顶层1%人群的财富份额下降约2个百分点，顶层10%人群下降1.5个百分点，而底层50%人群的财富份额上升0.4个百分点，底层20%人群上升0.15个百分点。这些效应逐步显现，在改革实施四年内达到统计显著性，并在整个观测期内持续存在。该结果在替代估计量、替代腐败指标以及控制滞后因变量、国民收入、顶层1%收入份额、政治暴力与通货膨胀的模型设定中均保持稳健。对格鲁吉亚的综合控制分析表明，改革如何瓦解精英庇护网络，而随后的政策逆转导致分配收益停滞。本研究拓展了政治经济学文献，揭示精英瓦解机制主导了对非正式再分配问题的抵消性担忧，且改革通过扩大金融服务与产权获取渠道（而非直接财政转移）重塑财富分配格局。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Political power and wealth distribution: how anti-corruption reforms reshape inequality
title_zh: 政治权力与财富分配：反腐败改革如何重塑不平等

abstract: I study the economic consequences of cultural diversity within political organizations. Using manually collected data on 25,568 members of county-level standing committees of the Chinese Communist Party and the Chinese Industrial Enterprise Database from 1998 to 2013, I find that cultural diversity in county standing committees significantly reduces industrial output. I further identify potential mechanisms: greater committee diversity is associated with lower government and capital construction spending, slower and weaker responses to public appeals, and lower labor and capital inputs as well as enterprise investment. Moreover, counties with more culturally diverse standing committees exhibit lower nighttime light intensity and reduced per capita GDP. Overall, these results highlight a potential limitation of China’s current political organizational structure and institutional arrangements.
abstract_zh: 我研究了政治组织内部文化多样性的经济后果。基于手动收集的1998年至2013年间中国共产党县级常务委员会25568名成员数据及中国工业企业数据库，发现县级常委会的文化多样性显著降低了工业产出。进一步识别出潜在机制：委员会多样性程度越高，政府与基建支出越低，对公众诉求的响应速度与力度越弱，劳动与资本投入及企业投资也相应减少。此外，文化多样性更高的县级常委会所在地区，夜间灯光强度与人均GDP均有所下降。总体而言，这些结果揭示了中国现行政治组织结构与制度安排可能存在的局限性。

abstract: This paper investigates why Imperial Japan’s promising Taishō-era democracy (1905–32) experienced a gradual descent into militarism that culminated in the collapse of party government and the effective subordination of civilian authority to the military by the late 1930s. Building on North et al.’s (2009) framework, I argue that this democratic reversal was driven by a failure to consolidate civilian control over the instruments of violence. Facing the existential threat of Russian expansion, civilian elites made a deliberate decision to empower the military at a moment when civilian institutional control over the armed forces was weak and the military technology being adopted concentrated coercive power in a professional officer corps insulated from civilian oversight. This combination produced a substantial probability of eventual military takeover, which was realized over the following three decades as each remaining instrument of civilian authority was tested and broken in turn. This trajectory is contrasted with that of Britain, where civilian institutional control over the military had been consolidated two centuries before industrial warfare arrived. Comparable military technologies were later absorbed there into an existing civilian chain of command and kept under civilian direction. I identify a distinct pathway of democratic backsliding and demonstrate that the strength of civilian institutional control and the character of available military technology at the moment of military empowerment are critical determinants of whether democracy endures.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨为何日本帝国颇具前景的大正时代民主（1905–1932年）逐渐滑向军国主义，最终导致政党政府崩溃，并在1930年代末期使文官权力实质上从属于军方。基于诺斯等人（2009年）的分析框架，本文认为，这一民主倒退的根源在于未能巩固文官对暴力工具的控制。面对俄国扩张的生存威胁，文官精英在文官对军队的制度性控制薄弱、且所采用的军事技术将强制力集中于不受文官监督的职业军官团之际，刻意做出了强化军方的决策。这种组合导致军方最终接管政权的概率显著上升，并在随后的三十年间逐一检验并瓦解了剩余的文官权威工具。本文将此路径与英国进行对比——英国在工业战争到来前两个世纪便已巩固了文官对军队的制度性控制。后来引入的同类军事技术被纳入既有文官指挥体系，并始终处于文官主导之下。本文识别出一条独特的民主倒退路径，并证明：在军事权力被赋予的时刻，文官制度性控制的强度与可用军事技术的特性，是决定民主能否存续的关键因素。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Imperial Japan, civilian control, and democratic reversal
title_zh: 日本帝国、文官统治与民主逆转

abstract: We study women’s underrepresentation in science by experimentally examining gender imbalance in music composition and whether it is due to unfair judgment in evaluative settings. We invite composition faculty to rate new compositions associated with randomly assigned gendered names along with live recordings directed by the same conductor. We find no evidence of gender bias against women, and in fact compositions associated with female names are rated higher than those associated with male names. Further, reviewers do not favor compositions by composers of their own gender. We find suggestive evidence that male faculty and senior faculty favor female composers in both overall and structured evaluations. These findings should be interpreted with caution, as the study’s external validity is limited by the modest response rate and demographic composition of respondents.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究音乐创作中的性别失衡现象，探讨其是否源于评审环境中的不公正判断，以此考察科学领域中女性代表性不足的问题。我们邀请作曲系教师对随机分配性别化名字的新作品进行评分，并同时提供由同一指挥家指挥的现场录音。结果显示，我们没有发现针对女性的性别偏见证据，事实上，与男性名字关联的作品相比，女性名字关联的作品获得了更高的评分。此外，评审者并未偏好与自己性别相同的作曲家。我们发现有提示性证据表明，男性教师和资深教师在整体及结构化评价中均更倾向于女性作曲家。然而，这些发现应谨慎解读，因为研究的回应率及受访者人口构成有限，限制了其外部有效性。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Gender bias in competitive music composition evaluation: an experimental study
title_zh: 竞争性音乐创作评估中的性别偏见：一项实验研究

abstract: Academic institutions and governance bodies are implementing rules that restrict the use of AI tools in research. This paper develops a formal interest-group theory of AI-tool governance in science, modeling such rules as the endogenous outcome of organized conflict within the scientific community over policies adopted by journals, funders, departments, and professional associations. Scientists differ in how much they gain from AI tools, while rank-relevant rewards, such as publication opportunities, grants, promotions, prizes, and professional recognition, depend partly on relative standing. Even when AI tools raise aggregate knowledge production, scientists with smaller AI-related productivity gains can invest resources to secure restrictions that compress rivals’ rank advantages. The equilibrium likelihood of restriction, lobbying expenditures, and rent dissipation are characterized in closed form in a Tullock contest framework. The model yields a welfare wedge: because rank-based rewards are privately valuable and partly positional, the chosen rules can be excessively restrictive relative to the social optimum. The mechanism is most relevant where governance bodies retain substantial discretion over rule-setting and where scientists cannot easily avoid restrictive policies by shifting to other venues. Restrictions are more likely when disclosure, sanction, or reputational concerns about AI use are more prominent, and when scientists favoring stricter rules are better represented in rule-setting bodies or better able to coordinate pressure for restriction. When scientists’ average net private gain from permissive AI use is positive, restrictions are also more likely when rank incentives are steeper and when AI increases the relative-performance advantage of high-complementarity scientists. The analysis yields testable predictions that distinguish this interest-group account from a public-interest account of AI-tool governance.
abstract_zh: 学术机构和治理主体正在实施限制研究中使用人工智能工具的规定。本文发展了一个关于科学中人工智能工具治理的正式利益集团理论，将这些规则建模为科学界内部围绕期刊、资助机构、院系及专业协会所采纳政策而发生的组织化冲突的内生结果。科学家在从人工智能工具中获益的程度方面存在差异，而与排名相关的奖励，如发表机会、资助、晋升、奖项和专业认可，部分取决于相对地位。即使人工智能工具提高了总体知识生产，那些人工智能相关生产率收益较小的科学家也可能投入资源以争取限制措施，从而压缩竞争对手的排名优势。在塔洛克竞争框架下，限制的均衡概率、游说支出和租金耗散均以闭式解形式刻画。该模型产生了一个福利楔子：由于基于排名的奖励具有私人价值且部分具有地位性，所选择的规则相对于社会最优状态可能过度严格。该机制在治理机构对规则制定保留实质性自由裁量权、且科学家无法通过转向其他场所轻易规避限制性政策的情况下最为相关。当关于人工智能使用的披露、制裁或声誉担忧更为突出，且支持更严格规则的科学家在规则制定机构中代表性更强或更能协调施加限制压力时，限制更可能发生。当科学家对允许使用人工智能的平均净私人收益为正时，若排名激励更为陡峭，且人工智能增加了高互补性科学家的相对绩效优势，限制也更可能发生。该分析产生了可检验的预测，将这一利益集团解释与人工智能工具治理的公共利益解释区分开来。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: An interest-group theory of AI-tool governance in science
title_zh: 人工智能工具治理的利益集团理论

abstract: In his latest book, Dr. Aris Trantidis offers a new theory of clientelism. Supported by a careful reconceptualization of the term that avoids both conceptual stretching and excessive narrowing, and drawing on evidence from case studies that normally remain underexamined in the wider public choice literature, such as Greece and Argentina, the author describes how clientelism is a fundamental force in liberal-democratic politics, holding electoral politics and public policy hostage to the interests of a caste of clients and rendering constitutional limits on clientelist power obsolete (Trantidis 2024). In the author’s words, “Clientelism refers to the provision of resources and advantages by political actors—the patrons—to their clients through an agreement in which these benefits are made conditional on the beneficiaries’ political support in return” (p. 6). The reciprocal transaction in the definition avoids conceptual stretching by excluding pork-barrel politics, which does not demand anything in return from constituencies (p. 8). Furthermore, it distances clientelism from general interest-group politics, which is a broader category that can include lobbying without an obligation on the part of the patron (p. 9). Moreover, it does not conceptually narrow clientelism to electoral dynamics alone. Past public choice articles have tended to analyze patron-client relations and interest group politics only to the extent they affect electoral processes. For example, one study examines systems in which political parties are dedicated to clientelist exchange, purely through electoral strategies of vote-buying and turnout-buying (Gans-Morse et al. 2014). By contrast, Trantidis makes an original contribution to the field by expanding our view of clientelism to arenas that do not ordinarily fall under scholarly scrutiny. These arenas constitute a layer of horizontal links across clients in various institutions (labor unions, state-owned enterprises, private companies), all interacting with public administration, parties, and individual patrons (p. 27). Such horizontal connections are important to highlight, Trantidis argues, because they represent a “preselectorate”, in that securing influential clients from such sectors determines who will have the resources to compete and win an election and select for the type of policy platform which must satisfy clients before traditional vertical relationships between policymakers and the electorate ever enter the picture (pg.45). Two empirical examples, Greece (p. 55) and Argentina (p. 66), are of utmost importance to Trantidis because they illustrate how clientelist interests override even the necessity of resolving a fiscal crisis (Argentina) or reversing known policy failures (Greece).
abstract_zh: 在其最新著作中，阿里斯·特兰蒂迪斯博士提出了一种关于庇护主义的新理论。通过对该术语进行细致的重新概念化，既避免了概念过度延伸，也防止了过度狭隘化，并借鉴了公共选择文献中通常较少考察的案例研究证据，如希腊和阿根廷，作者阐述了庇护主义如何成为自由民主政治中的一股根本力量，使选举政治和公共政策受制于一群庇护对象的利益，并使对庇护权力的宪法限制形同虚设（Trantidis 2024）。用作者的话说，“庇护主义指的是政治行动者——即庇护者——通过一种协议向其庇护对象提供资源和优势，这些利益以受益人提供政治支持作为回报为条件”（第6页）。该定义中的互惠交易排除了猪肉桶政治，从而避免了概念延伸，因为猪肉桶政治不要求选区提供任何回报（第8页）。此外，它使庇护主义区别于一般的利益集团政治，后者是一个更广泛的范畴，可以包括游说活动，而不要求庇护者承担义务（第9页）。再者，它并未在概念上将庇护主义局限于选举动态。以往的公共选择文章往往仅在影响选举过程的范围内分析庇护者-庇护对象关系和利益集团政治。例如，一项研究考察了政党致力于庇护交换的制度，纯粹通过买票和买 turnout 的选举策略来实现（Gans-Morse et al. 2014）。相比之下，特兰蒂迪斯通过将我们对庇护主义的视野扩展到通常不受学术审视的领域，为该领域做出了原创性贡献。这些领域构成了各机构（工会、国有企业、私营公司）中庇护对象之间的横向联系层，所有这些都与公共行政、政党和个别庇护者互动（第27页）。特兰蒂迪斯认为，这些横向联系值得强调，因为它们代表了一个“预选选民群体”，因为从这些部门获得有影响力的庇护对象决定了谁将拥有资源和能力来竞争并赢得选举，并选择必须满足庇护对象的政策平台类型，而这一切都发生在政策制定者与选民之间的传统纵向关系进入视野之前（第45页）。两个实证案例，希腊（第55页）和阿根廷（第66页），对特兰蒂迪斯至关重要，因为它们说明了庇护利益如何甚至凌驾于解决财政危机（阿根廷）或扭转已知政策失败（希腊）的必要性之上。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Aris Trantidis, Clientelism. Shaftesbury Road, Cambridge: Cambridge University Press, 2025. iv + 84 pages. USD 23 (paperback)
title_zh: 《庇护主义》

abstract: Adam Smith’s account of medieval towns in Book III of The Wealth of Nations remains one of the most influential analyses of how commerce transformed feudal Europe. This paper formalizes Smith’s argument as a game between kings, lords, and towns. The king-town alliance emphasized by Adam Smith emerges when towns are wealthy enough to offer fiscal and military support but lords remain a serious threat. However, when kings become excessively predatory, towns may ally with lords (as in the Magna Carta crisis); when towns are too weak to offer substantial support, kings ally with lords instead (as in Eastern Europe). A dynamic extension shows that the king-town equilibrium is self-undermining: commercial growth erodes lordly military power through Smith’s “diamond buckles” mechanism, eventually enabling royal absolutism. In contrast, the king-lords equilibrium is self-reinforcing, suppressing urban development and preserving feudal institutions. The framework highlights how small differences in initial urban development could generate dramatically different long-run trajectories and illuminates both the brilliance and the limitations of Smith’s conjectural history.
abstract_zh: 亚当·斯密在《国富论》第三卷中对中世纪城镇的论述，至今仍是分析商业如何改变封建欧洲最具影响力的理论之一。本文将斯密的论点形式化为国王、领主与城镇之间的博弈模型。当城镇足够富裕，能够提供财政与军事支持，而领主仍构成严重威胁时，斯密所强调的国王-城镇联盟便会形成。然而，当国王变得过度掠夺性时，城镇可能与领主结盟（如《大宪章》危机时期）；当城镇过于弱小、无法提供实质性支持时，国王则转而与领主结盟（如东欧地区）。动态扩展模型表明，国王-城镇均衡具有自我削弱性：商业增长通过斯密的“钻石扣带”机制侵蚀领主的军事力量，最终促成君主专制。相反，国王-领主均衡具有自我强化性，抑制城市发展并维系封建制度。该框架揭示了初始城市发展的微小差异如何导致截然不同的长期演化路径，并阐明了斯密推测性历史理论的洞见与局限。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Adam Smith and the role of the towns in feudal Europe
title_zh: 亚当·斯密与封建欧洲城镇的角色

abstract: Liberal democracies increasingly curtail civil liberties in response to cultural tensions. I show that such repression can be conceived as a Pigouvian political externality: governments enjoy immediate political benefits from reduced social tension but systematically undervalue long-run costs of institutional erosion. The externality arises because finite tenure and reduced post-tenure valuation make politicians discount institutional quality more steeply than society. I formalize this mechanism in a dynamic linear-quadratic model in which repression lowers visible tension today while degrading future institutional quality, and I derive a closed-form “social cost of repression,” analogous to the social cost of carbon in environmental economics. Pigouvian logic, typically used to diagnose market failure, is here applied to a government failure in democratic self-regulation. I then characterize a class of market-based instruments—sovereign “democracy covenant” bonds, whose coupon rates rise automatically when civil-liberties indices deteriorate—that embed the shadow cost of repression into borrowing costs and thereby better align short-run political incentives with long-run democratic resilience.
abstract_zh: 自由民主政体在应对文化紧张局势时，日益限制公民自由。本文论证此类压制可被理解为一种庇古式政治外部性：政府从社会紧张局势缓解中即时获得政治收益，却系统性低估制度侵蚀的长期成本。这种外部性源于有限任期与离任后价值折损，导致政治家对制度质量的折现率高于社会整体。本文通过动态线性二次模型形式化该机制——压制行为在降低当前显性紧张的同时，持续削弱未来制度质量，并推导出类似环境经济学中"碳社会成本"的"压制社会成本"闭合解。通常用于诊断市场失灵的庇古逻辑，在此被应用于民主自我规制中的政府失灵。进而，本文刻画了一类市场型工具——主权"民主契约"债券，其票面利率随公民自由指数恶化自动攀升——通过将压制的影子成本内化至借贷成本，使短期政治激励与长期民主韧性实现更优校准。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Democratic backsliding as a Pigouvian political externality
title_zh: 民主倒退作为庇古式政治外部性

abstract: This study examines an under-explored implication of population ageing: its relationship with environmental outcomes at the country level and environmental attitudes at the individual level. The analysis introduces a novel classification of environmental outcomes, distinguishing between action-requiring and nature-concerning dimensions based on the degree of civic engagement necessary for their realisation. Using panel data from a broad set of countries over the period 1995–2018, population ageing is shown to be associated with improvements in environmental outcomes that require limited civic engagement, while no systematic relationship is observed for outcomes that rely on active public participation. Complementary evidence from individual-level survey data for 2005–2016 indicates that ageing societies exhibit lower levels of environmental engagement, without a corresponding decline in underlying environmental concern. The findings contribute to the literature on demographic change and environmental performance by highlighting the role of civic engagement as a mediating mechanism and suggest that ageing societies may face specific challenges in sustaining participatory forms of environmental action.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了人口老龄化一个尚未充分挖掘的影响：其在国家层面与环境结果、个体层面与环境态度之间的关系。分析引入了一种新的环境结果分类方法，根据实现这些结果所需的公民参与程度，将其区分为“需要行动型”和“关注自然型”两个维度。利用1995–2018年间多个国家的面板数据，研究发现人口老龄化与那些需要有限公民参与的环境结果的改善相关，而对于依赖公众积极参与的环境结果，则未观察到系统性关联。基于2005–2016年个体层面调查数据的补充证据表明，老龄化社会中的环境参与水平较低，但潜在的环境关注并未相应下降。这些发现通过强调公民参与作为中介机制的作用，为人口变化与环境绩效的相关文献做出了贡献，并表明老龄化社会在维持参与式环境行动方面可能面临特定挑战。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Population Ageing and the Environment: A Comparative Study of Nature-Concerning and Action-Requiring Outcomes
title_zh: 人口老龄化与环境：自然关注型与行动需求型结果的比较研究

abstract: We examine the economic impact of regulating new genomic techniques on investment decisions in the EU. Using a real options model, we compare five major regulatory options (nine including sub-options) with the status quo and analyse their effects on plant breeders’ investments. Using the current authorization process for genetically modified organisms for NGTs presents a high investment barrier for companies. The findings indicate that all alternative five options offer opportunities to reduce investment hurdles, depending on the design of the authorization process. Our model and its calibration serve as an example for further advancing the application of real options for regulatory policy analysis.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了欧盟对新基因组技术进行监管对投资决策的经济影响。通过使用实物期权模型，我们比较了五种主要监管方案（含子方案共九种）与现状的差异，并分析了它们对植物育种者投资的影响。将当前转基因生物授权流程应用于新基因组技术，对企业构成了较高的投资门槛。研究结果表明，所有五种替代方案均提供了降低投资障碍的机会，具体效果取决于授权流程的设计。我们的模型及其校准为推进实物期权在监管政策分析中的应用提供了范例。
title: Comparing the effects of regulating new genomic techniques on investment decisions in the European Union
title_zh: 比较欧盟监管新基因组技术对投资决策的影响

abstract: Based on the System of National Accounts (SNA) and the European System of Accounts (ESA), land is classified as a natural resource and a non-produced non-financial asset. Due to its significant share in an economy’s assets, evaluating the value of land is crucial for preparing the national balance sheet and national wealth. This requires classifying land types according to their use and pricing them accordingly. The main types of land include land underlying dwellings, land underlying other buildings and structures, agricultural, and forestry lands. This study estimates the value of land as an economic asset in Iran, providing the first comprehensive evaluation of various land types in the country. Lands underlying dwellings are valued using residual (benchmark approach), net present value (NPV), and land-to-structure ratio (LSR) methods. Lands underlying other buildings and structures are valued using the LSR method, while agricultural and forestry lands are valued based on the NPV of expected future incomes. The results of this study show that the total estimated value of land in Iran ranges from IRR 32,862 trillion to IRR 918,986 trillion during 2015–2023. Lands underlying dwellings constitute the largest share of this value at 45.59%, with the household sector being the largest owner. Agricultural lands have the second-largest share, followed by land underlying buildings other than dwellings (on average, approximately 32.66% and 21.56%, respectively), while forest lands have the smallest share of the total land value (on average 0.19%).
abstract_zh: 根据国民账户体系（SNA）与欧洲账户体系（ESA），土地被归类为自然资源及非生产性非金融资产。鉴于土地在经济体资产中占据重要份额，评估土地价值对于编制国家资产负债表和国家财富至关重要。这要求根据土地用途对其类型进行分类，并据此定价。主要土地类型包括住宅用地、其他建筑物和构筑物用地、农业用地及林业用地。本研究估算了伊朗作为经济资产的土地价值，首次对该国各类土地进行了全面评估。住宅用地采用剩余法（基准法）、净现值法（NPV）及土地与建筑物比率法（LSR）进行估值；其他建筑物和构筑物用地采用LSR法估值；农业和林业用地则基于预期未来收入的净现值进行估值。研究结果显示，2015年至2023年间，伊朗土地总价值估计介于32,862万亿伊朗里亚尔至918,986万亿伊朗里亚尔之间。其中，住宅用地占总价值的最大份额，为45.59%，住户部门是最大的所有者。农业用地占比次之，其后依次为除住宅外的建筑物用地（平均分别约为32.66%和21.56%），而林业用地在土地总价值中占比最小（平均为0.19%）。
title: Estimating the value of land in Iran’s economy
title_zh: 估算伊朗经济中土地的价值

abstract: We experimentally investigate preferences for clumping-versus-separating information in the gain and the loss domains, and also preferences for timing. Our design is motivated by the idea that information preferences may depend on reference points. Subjects participate in two monetary lotteries and choose how to receive the outcome information. For half of the subjects, the lotteries are framed as two gain lotteries; for the other half, as two loss lotteries. Based on Thaler (1985) one can expect that people want to learn the outcomes of the gain lotteries separately and the outcomes of the loss lotteries clumped together (cf. hedonic editing hypothesis). On the other hand, a different reference dependent model by Koszegi and Rabin (2009) relies on expectations-based reference points, and predicts that subjects should prefer clumped information irrespective of the frame. The results of our experiment show a preference for separating information about gains, and no preference for clumping or separating information about losses. Regarding timing, we find a weak overall preference for receiving information sooner. These findings provide new insights into information preferences. We conclude by discussing policy implications, as well as our additional contributions to related literature.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了人们在收益域和损失域中对信息聚合与分离的偏好，以及对信息获取时机的偏好。实验设计基于信息偏好可能依赖于参照点的理论假设。受试者参与两项货币抽奖，并选择如何接收结果信息。其中一半受试者的抽奖被设定为两项收益抽奖，另一半则为两项损失抽奖。根据Thaler（1985）的理论，人们可能倾向于分别了解收益抽奖的结果，而将损失抽奖的结果合并了解（参见享乐编辑假说）。另一方面，Koszegi和Rabin（2009）提出的基于期望参照点的不同参照依赖模型则预测，无论抽奖框架如何，受试者都应偏好信息聚合。实验结果显示，受试者偏好将收益信息分离呈现，而对损失信息则未表现出聚合或分离的明确偏好。在时机方面，我们发现受试者整体上微弱偏好尽早获取信息。这些发现为信息偏好研究提供了新见解。最后，我们讨论了政策含义及对相关文献的额外贡献。
title: Information preferences, reference points and hedonic editing: experimental evidence
title_zh: 信息偏好、参照点与享乐编辑：实验证据

abstract: Boundary discontinuity designs are used to learn about causal treatment effects along a continuous assignment boundary that splits units into control and treatment groups according to a bivariate location score. We analyze location-based local polynomial treatment effect estimators that directly employ the bivariate score of each unit. We develop pointwise and uniform estimation and inference methods for the \textit{Boundary Average Treatment Effect Curve} (BATEC), as well as for two aggregated causal parameters: the \textit{Weighted Boundary Average Treatment Effect} (WBATE) and the \textit{Largest Boundary Average Treatment Effect} (LBATE). Our results cover both sharp and fuzzy (imperfect compliance) designs. We illustrate the methods with an empirical application, and provide companion general-purpose software. The supplemental appendix includes additional substantive theoretical results, methodological details, and simulation evidence.
abstract_zh: 边界不连续设计用于沿连续分配边界学习因果处理效应，该边界根据二元位置得分将单位划分为对照组和处理组。我们分析了直接利用每个单位的二元得分的基于位置局部多项式处理效应估计量。我们为《边界平均处理效应曲线》（BATEC）以及两个聚合因果参数：《加权边界平均处理效应》（WBATE）和《最大边界平均处理效应》（LBATE）开发了点态和一致估计及推断方法。我们的结果涵盖锐利和模糊（不完全依从）设计。我们通过一个实证应用展示了这些方法，并提供了配套的通用软件。补充附录包含额外的实质性理论结果、方法论细节和模拟证据。
source_issue: Journal of Econometrics, Volume 256, Part A
title: Estimation and inference in boundary discontinuity designs: Distance-based methods
title_zh: 边界断点设计中的估计与推断：基于距离的方法

abstract: This paper investigates the agglomeration spillovers from the beet sugar industry, which was supported by the U.S. government as an industrial policy to encourage rural development during the early twentieth century. To estimate the effects of plant openings, I identify suitable locations for beet sugar plants from a historical trade journal and find that these plant openings had large and long-lasting effects on population and manufacturing activities over one hundred years. The local jobs multiplier was significantly larger in less populated areas, suggesting that low congestion in sparsely settled regions enabled a sizeable impact. The agglomeration spillovers benefited industries not only directly linked through input–output linkages but also extended to broader, less related industries outside the production chain of agricultural processing.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了甜菜制糖业的集聚溢出效应，该产业在二十世纪初作为美国政府鼓励农村发展的产业政策而受到支持。为估计工厂设立的影响，我从历史贸易期刊中识别出适合建立甜菜制糖厂的地点，并发现这些工厂的设立对人口和制造业活动产生了持续逾百年的显著且长久的影响。在人口较少的地区，本地就业乘数明显更大，这表明稀疏定居地区的低拥挤程度使得影响得以显著扩大。集聚溢出不仅惠及通过投入产出关联直接相连的产业，还延伸至农业生产链之外更广泛、关联度较低的产业。
title: Industrial spillovers from agricultural processing: Evidence from the beet sugar industry
title_zh: 农业加工产业的工业溢出效应：来自甜菜制糖业的证据

abstract: During the 2020–2021 “AAPI Hate,” mutual funds led by female managers perceived as East Asian underperformed relative to other female managers. This effect is stronger in states with higher anti-Asian animus, among more actively managed funds, and when these managers hold sole or senior roles. Factors concurrent with COVID-19, including childcare challenges, concerns for overseas families, marketplace and workplace discrimination, and exposure to the Chinese economy, cannot explain the effect. Underperformance is traceable to poor stock picking due to impairments in generating private information. Racial-ethnic animosity, even outside workplace or marketplace, hinders productivity and decision-making in high-skill professions.
abstract_zh: 在2020-2021年“亚裔美国人仇恨事件”期间，由被视为东亚裔的女性基金经理管理的共同基金，其表现逊于其他女性基金经理。这一效应在反亚裔情绪更强烈的州、主动管理程度更高的基金中更为显著，且当这些基金经理担任唯一或高级管理职务时尤为突出。与新冠疫情同步发生的因素，包括育儿挑战、对海外家人的担忧、职场与市场歧视以及中国经济敞口，均无法解释该效应。业绩不佳可追溯至因私有信息生成能力受损导致的选股失误。种族-民族敌意，即便发生在职场或市场之外，也会阻碍高技能职业的生产力与决策能力。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: The Real Effect of Sociopolitical Racial/Ethnic Animus: Mutual Fund Manager Performance during AAPI Hate
title_zh: 社会政治种族/民族敌意的真实效应：AAPI仇恨事件期间的共同基金经理表现

abstract: Emerging economy central banks often hold large FX reserves while residents carry substantial local-currency-linked external liabilities. With financial frictions creating interest parity gaps, such opposing positions imply a carry cost. In a small open economy with intermediation frictions and inherited local-currency debt, we study optimal reserve and exchange rate policies, explaining why debtor economies may retain reserves rather than netting out costly gross positions. While policy can eliminate costly intermediation by deploying reserves and appreciating the real exchange rate, doing so creates a general equilibrium revaluation effect which raises the real burden of local-currency obligations. Optimal policy retains reserves, accepting some intermediation to avoid a larger revaluation loss. This policy is time-inconsistent: a discretionary central bank prefers stronger ex-post appreciation; a time-consistent equilibrium features more reserve retention and larger interest parity gaps. Revaluation costs restrain reserve deployment; when large, optimal policy retains more reserves during disruptions than in normal times.
abstract_zh: 新兴经济体央行通常持有大量外汇储备，而居民则承担着大量与本币挂钩的外部负债。在金融摩擦导致利率平价缺口存在的情况下，这种对立头寸意味着一种持有成本。在一个存在中介摩擦和继承性本币债务的小型开放经济体中，我们研究最优储备与汇率政策，解释为何债务经济体可能保留储备而非抵消高成本的总额头寸。尽管政策可以通过动用储备并促使实际汇率升值来消除昂贵的中介活动，但这样做会产生一般均衡重估效应，从而提高本币债务的实际负担。最优政策保留储备，接受一定程度的中介活动，以避免更大的重估损失。该政策存在时间不一致性：一个具有自由裁量权的中央银行更倾向于事后更强的升值；而时间一致均衡则表现为更多储备保留和更大的利率平价缺口。重估成本制约储备的动用；当重估成本较大时，最优政策在危机期间保留的储备多于正常时期。
title: Financial frictions, FX reserves, and exchange rate management with local-currency debt
title_zh: 金融摩擦、外汇储备与本地货币债务下的汇率管理

abstract: Berge equilibrium offers an alternative to Nash equilibrium in game theory, emphasizing cooperative stability rather than individual optimization. Despite recent interest, a systematic study of Berge equilibria in finite normal form games is still lacking, with fundamental questions like existence remaining open. This paper characterizes Berge equilibria through a polynomial system of equations, enabling computational algebra and algebraic geometry methods to analyze them. Algorithms based on Gröbner bases determine the existence and computation of Berge equilibria. Furthermore, we show that the set of games admitting completely mixed Berge equilibria is contained within a determinantal variety, whose dimension we explicitly bound from above.
abstract_zh: 伯格均衡为博弈论中的纳什均衡提供了一种替代方案，强调合作稳定性而非个体最优化。尽管近期研究兴趣渐增，但有限正规型博弈中伯格均衡的系统性研究仍显不足，诸如存在性等基本问题尚未解决。本文通过多项式方程组刻画伯格均衡，从而能够运用计算代数和代数几何方法对其进行分析。基于格罗布纳基的算法可判定伯格均衡的存在性并实现其计算。此外，我们证明存在完全混合伯格均衡的博弈集合包含于某一行列式簇中，并给出了该簇维数的显式上界。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Berge equilibria – an algebraic approach
title_zh: 伯格均衡——一种代数方法

abstract: We use a quantitative spatial equilibrium model to evaluate the distributional and welfare impacts of a recent temporary rent control policy in Berlin, Germany. We calibrate the model to key features of Berlin’s housing market, in particular the recent gentrification of inner city locations. As expected, gentrification benefits rich homeowners, while poor renter households lose. Our counterfactual analysis mimicks the rent control policy. We find that this policy reduces welfare for rich and poor households and in fact, the percentage change in welfare is largest for the poorest households. We also study alternative affordable housing policies such as subsidies and re-zoning policies, which are better suited to address the adverse consequences of gentrification.
abstract_zh: 我们运用一个定量空间均衡模型，评估德国柏林近期实施的临时租金管制政策所带来的分配效应与福利影响。我们将模型校准至柏林住房市场的关键特征，特别是内城区位近期的绅士化现象。正如预期，绅士化使富裕房主受益，而贫困租房家庭则遭受损失。我们的反事实分析模拟了租金管制政策，发现该政策降低了富裕与贫困家庭的福利，且实际上，最贫困家庭的福利百分比变化最大。我们还研究了补贴和重新分区政策等替代性可负担住房政策，这些政策更适于应对绅士化带来的不利后果。
title: Gentrification and affordable housing policies
title_zh: 士绅化与可负担住房政策

abstract: This paper investigates the impact of trade liberalization on structural transformation, using quasi-experimental tariff reductions from Brazil's 1990s reforms. Building on recent cross-regional macroeconomic literature, we extend the traditional shift-share framework to estimate both local and spatial spillover effects on sectoral employment shares, providing insights on aggregate outcomes. Regions more exposed to tariff cuts saw declines in manufacturing employment, increases in the primary sector, and reductions in non-tradables. Spillover effects—mediated through migration or proximity—partially offset local deindustrialization in manufacturing but amplified declines in non-tradables. These effects persisted for over twenty years and proved robust to alternative explanations, including competing structural transformation hypotheses and other economic shocks during the period of analysis. Overall, our findings support theories highlighting comparative advantage as a potential driver of trade-induced structural transformation.
abstract_zh: 本文利用巴西1990年代改革中准实验性的关税削减，研究了贸易自由化对结构转型的影响。基于近期跨区域宏观经济文献，我们扩展了传统的转移-份额框架，以估计关税削减对部门就业份额的本地效应和空间溢出效应，从而揭示总体经济结果。关税削减暴露程度更高的地区经历了制造业就业下降、初级部门扩张以及非贸易部门收缩。通过移民或地理邻近性传导的溢出效应，部分抵消了制造业的本地去工业化，但加剧了非贸易部门的收缩。这些效应持续了二十多年，并在替代性解释（包括分析期间的其他经济冲击及竞争性结构转型假说）下依然稳健。总体而言，我们的研究结果支持了强调比较优势作为贸易驱动型结构转型潜在驱动力的理论。
title: Local and spillover effects of trade on structural transformation: Evidence from Brazil
title_zh: 贸易对结构转型的地方与溢出效应：来自巴西的证据
